training: All printed-evidence Hanon/Beringer cases already consumed in earlier research. Completed annotations are secondary evaluation only. No fresh Czerny labels or scores enter training or selection.
selection: No hyperparameter search. One fixed training schedule, final averaged weights after 8 deterministic epochs, both learners. No tuning after test results.
decoder: Exact classic candidate graph and physical transition constraints; unknown digits and wrist anchors remain latent. Reference oracle filters the unconstrained graph, never rebuilds geometry from labels. Source anchors always apply.
objective: Online latent structured perceptron with Hamming loss augmented inference on printed labels only; compatible latent completion recomputed under current weights at every update. Cost weights update toward compatible minus loss augmented preference, averaged over all examples including no-update examples.
scalar: Four active classic scalar costs; nonnegative projected weights initialized at one, normalized feature counts per example. Inactive classic components stay fixed.
structured: Same scalar features plus input-conditioned attack and pair preferences: black-key/finger, interval/digit transitions, direction and turn contexts, phrase starts/ends, repetition, thumb passage and key depth. Signed contextual weights bounded to [-4,4]; scalar costs remain nonnegative. No ergonomic geometry change.
evaluation: All reserved pieces and all old cases, no dropped unsupported hands. Printed and completed separate. Accuracy, complete sequences, coverage, physical conflicts, runtime, source-family results and paired piece differences. Do not promote automatically.
import: Use installed LilyPond parser on sanitized music variables, own AST dumper, preserve pitch/time/hand/voice/ties. Compound or ambiguous chord fingerings flagged and excluded only from eligible gold labels, never remove their notes. Retain import failures in inventory.
acceptance: Research comparison, not automatic product rollout. Require no new physical conflicts, constraints and input identity preserved, numerical/oracle tests passing, full local CI passing. Report agreement regressions honestly. Fresh-test failures do not authorize refitting.
